DTC 61 TRAC ECU Communication Circuit Malfunction

CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION

DTC No. | Diagnostic Trouble Code Detecting Condition | Trouble area

61
Either of the following (1) or (2) continues for more than 8 sec.:
(1) Vehicle speed signal of 4 wheels is less than 1 km/h (1 mph) when TRCO signal is input.
(2) Voltage of ABS & TRAC ECU terminal THFA is 0 V when TRCO signal is not input.
